calculation.description: Ranks the lagged three-day reversal signal after scaling by trailing 20-day realized volatility, making the reversal comparable across cross-asset instruments while avoiding look-ahead.

validation.period: 2020-01-01 through 2027-02-25 (usable dates depend on aligned history)
validation.regime_notes: Passed benchmark gates on the five-day paper horizon, with strong 2025-26 IC but negative 2027-to-date IC; recent drift requires monitoring. Small cross-asset universe and sparse aligned history warrant conservative interpretation.
